title: Amortised Inference through One-Step Implicit Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient sampling from Bayesian posterior distributions in high dimensions remains a hard problem, despite advances in theory and algorithms. Multiple steps are usually required to draw unbiased samples, for example, iterations of an MCMC algorithm or integration steps in a diffusion-based amortised sampler. However, scalable one-step amortised inference remains a challenging open problem. In this work, we build upon recent progress in data-driven generative modelling to offer a possible solution for one-step amortised sampling. Our one-step implicit sampler (OSIS) uses short-time MCMC dynamics to define a local target for the evolution of an implicitly modelled distribution. In the asymptotic limit, the modelled distribution is a fixed point of the MCMC kernel and thus samples from the target. translated_title: 通过单步隐式采样实现摊销式推断
translated_abstract: 尽管在理论和算法方面取得了进展，从高维贝叶斯后验分布中进行高效采样仍然是一个难题。通常需要多个步骤才能抽取无偏样本，例如MCMC算法的迭代，或基于扩散的摊销采样器中的积分步骤。然而，可扩展的单步摊销推断仍然是一个具有挑战性的开放问题。在本工作中，我们建立在数据驱动生成建模的最新进展之上，为单步摊销采样提供了一种可能的解决方案。我们的单步隐式采样器（OSIS）利用短时MCMC动力学为隐式建模分布的演化定义局部目标。在渐近极限下，所建模的分布成为MCMC核的不动点，因此其样本即来自目标分布。我们分析了OSIS的收敛性质，并展示了它与其他生成建模和采样算法之间的联系。我们研究了各种……
tldr: 提出单步隐式采样器（OSIS），利用短时MCMC动力学定义局部目标使建模分布成为MCMC核的不动点，从而实现高维贝叶斯后验分布的单步摊销采样。
en_tdlr: Proposes a One-Step Implicit Sampler (OSIS) that uses short-time MCMC dynamics to define local targets so the modeled distribution becomes a fixed point of the MCMC kernel, enabling one-step amortised sampling from high-dimensional Bayesian posteriors.
